shared-tool-onboarding-guide.title: Continue shared runner preparation
shared-tool-onboarding-guide.boundary: Shared runners use a separate Pool identity. Continue to check the current runner and project grant. This does not create an ordinary Runner identity or execute commands.
shared-tool-onboarding-guide.unavailable: Check the runner and selected tool again, or reconcile the original unconfirmed operation. An unavailable entry never falls back to ordinary runner setup.
shared-tool-onboarding-guide.output_hint: Local output reference: this is a selected path only. Explicitly generate and verify the file on the target machine before using the original Pool configuration. Private paths are not transferred here.
